title: The only unoriginate and endless divine procession is the Trinity's internal generation and spiration
english: The only divine procession that could be called unoriginate and endless is the generation of the one and only Son from the one and only Father, and from the same Father the projection of the one and only Holy Spirit. In this procession the Father's single source, which is paternal and ruling, or rather pre-unoriginate, moved into the pair seen in the Son and the Spirit, and came to rest at the Trinity, as our Theologian Gregory says.

orientation: Procopius opens his refutation of Proclus's chapter 140 by defining the one divine procession that is without beginning and without end.

title: Eternal illumination and the cycle of return
english: Those very things that were produced undergo change in their essence, and so they need another production in turn.
But the procession according to illumination proceeds from there eternally and endlessly: to some as first-given, to others as second-given, and so on in order.
The divine radiances are poured out for sharing, in proportion to the ranks, or rather the stations, of each being, down to the last things within them.
In this way all things also return, drawn upward to the one origin, and the eternal and endless circle is preserved for them both in their processions and in their returns.
But the procession of things subject to generation, corruption, and time has already been completed in its universal aspect.
